items.name: Municipalities & Housing
items.one: Urban infrastructure, permits, inspections, waste, GIS.
items.market: Sourced: Saudi real estate market USD 79.1B (2026) → USD 114.0B by 2031, 7.6% CAGR (Mordor Intelligence, Jun 2026). Riyadh faces a 305,000-unit housing gap through 2034.
items.why: Direct extension of LandSmart/BuildSmart, already the most developed Trovec products — this is the flagship sector, not a new build.

items.name: Communications & IT
items.one: Enterprise AI automation, document AI, workflow.
items.market: Sourced: Saudi Arabia declared 2026 the "Year of Artificial Intelligence" under SDAIA, a national digital-transformation priority.
items.why: Treated as a feature layer inside LandSmart and Fiscra, not a standalone product competing with SDAIA-scale national AI initiatives.

items.name: Finance
items.one: Accounting, audit, tax, compliance, CFO services.
items.market: Sourced: SAMA's Open Banking Framework has been live since 2023; ZATCA e-invoicing (Fatoora) integration phases are ongoing and mandatory for applicable businesses.
items.why: Fiscra already exists as working software and is one of two Tier A products — built on the founder's CPA/AFA/audit-governance background.

items.name: Transport & Logistics
items.market: Sourced: Saudi logistics market projected at USD 38.8B by 2026 (5.85% CAGR); Vision 2030 targets 55% of GCC logistics market share (Maersk / Arab News, 2025).
items.why: Deliberately held: no Trovec team or delivered logistics work exists yet, despite genuine Saudi market size.

items.name: Health
items.market: Reliable specific market-size data not gathered for this profile; Vision 2030's broader healthcare transformation program is the directional signal.
items.why: Adjacent to Raymark Healthcare, a separate business line — not a Trovec software product today. Any clinical AI would require formal regulatory validation.

items.name: Riyadh Smart City
items.market: Directional: Riyadh giga-project capital deployment (NEOM, The Line) is well-documented policy direction; no Trovec-specific figure exists.
items.why: A natural LandSmart extension once a Saudi government relationship exists — not pursued speculatively.

items.name: Zakat, Tax & Customs

items.market: Sourced: ZATCA e-invoicing (Fatoora) integration phases are an active, checkable compliance requirement for applicable Saudi businesses.
items.why: The ZATCA e-invoicing requirement already matters to Fiscra directly — this sector is a natural Fiscra extension, not a new product.

items.why: SafeVoyage remains concept-only with no tourism-sector operating evidence; not pursued for a specialized zone at this stage.
